svg.aria-label: Constructed quantitative experiment with a fixed seed. The true unknown concentration is 13 micrograms/mL; calibration uses three repeats per level. Shading marks the target integration interval. Residuals are measured calibration areas minus fitted areas. The final panel varies the integration window to show the contribution of peak wings.
